cat > analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
import arena
b=arena.load_board()
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
for l in f:
 if l.strip()=='uciok':break
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
for l in f:
 if l.strip()=='readyok':break
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1])*1000))+(' searchmoves '+' '.join(sys.argv[2:]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else ''))
for l in f:
 if ' pv ' in l or l.startswith('bestmove'): print(l.strip(),flush=True)
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):break
send('quit')
PY

import arena,subprocess,sys
for i in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','analyze.py','30'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 lines=p.stdout.splitlines()
 print('\n'.join(lines[-2:]),flush=True)
 move=next(l.split()[1] for l in lines if l.startswith('bestmove'))
 arena.cmd_move(move)
 sys.stdout.flush()
